description_en: Queries the assets to which a control policy applies
description_zh: 获取指定控制策略生效资产范围
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-policy-asset-scope --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPolicyAssetScope

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The control policy ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to query the control policy ID
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

AssetScope.description_en: The assets to which the control policy applies
AssetScope.description_zh: 控制策略生效的资产范围

Databases.description_en: The databases and database accounts to which the control policy applies
Databases.description_zh: 控制策略生效的数据库资产列表

AccountScopeType.description_en:
The scope of database accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

All: The control policy applies to all database accounts of the database.

AccountId: The control policy applies to specified database accounts of the database
AccountScopeType.description_zh:
控制策略生效的数据库账户范围。取值：

All：针对数据库中的所有账户生效
AccountId：针对数据库中指定的账户生效

DatabaseAccountIds.description_en: The IDs of database accounts to which the control policy applies
DatabaseAccountIds.description_zh: 控制策略生效的数据库账户ID列表

HostGroups.description_en: The asset groups and asset accounts to which the control policy applies
HostGroups.description_zh: 控制策略生效的资产组范围

AccountNames.description_en: The asset accounts to which the control policy applies
AccountNames.description_zh: 控制策略生效的资产账户范围

items.description_en: The username of the asset account

AccountScopeType.description_en:
The scope of asset accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

All: The control policy applies to all accounts in the asset group.

AccountName: The control policy applies to specified accounts in the asset group
AccountScopeType.description_zh:
控制策略生效的资产账户范围。取值：

All：针对资产组中的所有账户生效
AccountName：针对资产组中指定的账户生效

Hosts.description_en: The hosts and host accounts to which the control policy applies
Hosts.description_zh: 控制策略生效的主机范围

AccountScopeType.description_en:
The scope of host accounts to which the control policy applies. Valid values:

All: The control policy applies to all accounts of the host.

AccountId: The control policy applies to specified accounts of the host
AccountScopeType.description_zh:
控制策略生效的主机账户范围。取值：

All：针对主机中的所有账户生效
AccountId：针对主机中指定的账户生效

HostAccountIds.description_en: The host accounts to which the control policy applies
HostAccountIds.description_zh: 控制策略生效的主机账户范围

ScopeType.description_en:
The scope of assets to which the control policy applies.

If All is returned for this parameter, the control policy applies to all assets.

If no value is returned for this parameter, the control policy applies to the assets specified in the return values of Databases, HostGroups, and Hosts
ScopeType.description_zh:
控制策略生效的资产范围。

返回All时表示控制策略针对所有资产生效。
返回空值表示策略对指定资产生效，具体生效范围为Databases、HostGroups和Hosts的返回值

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
